description: Durable task state, evidence-backed self-completion, and task-aware history retention.
note: Use this ability's toggle to enable Task Progress. Configure modes and behavior in Config ▸ Modes.
skill_summary: Always-on task authoring guidance: define one outcome per task, order work by dependency and user priority, and require observable evidence before completion.

settings.label: Completed-Task Carryover Tokens
settings.hint: Maximum completed-task tool evidence retained after the active task. Current-task evidence remains until Context Control needs to reduce history.

settings.label: Allow Self-Completion
settings.hint: Allow the working agent to complete a task when the durable evidence supports it.
